policy.directives: @comment, @preamble e @string non sono voci bibliografiche e non vengono mai emesse come tali
policy.field_order: author, editor, title, booktitle, journal, publisher, year, date, volume, number, pages, doi, url, keywords, note, abstract, poi i campi sconosciuti in ordine alfabetico
policy.indent: due spazi, una coppia chiave = {valore} per riga
policy.macro_expansion: false: un riferimento @string viene conservato testualmente dopo #
policy.value_delimiters: chiavi {...} e virgolette "..." sono equivalenti in fase di lettura
policy.unbalanced_values: un valore con graffe non bilanciate viene emesso tra virgolette e segnalato come avviso
policy.truncation: una voce non chiusa non viene emessa e il documento e marcato come troncato
policy.url_redaction: il campo url non conserva le credenziali

parse_vectors.name: a comment directive is not an entry and fields are re-ordered canonically
quoted values and string concatenation are read without expanding macros
a string directive is recorded and skipped
an unclosed entry yields no entry and marks the document truncated
the parenthesised entry form is accepted
braced values keep their inner braces and collapse whitespace
a byte order mark and CRLF terminators are accepted

format_vectors.name: canonical field order, two space indent and one trailing newline
unknown fields follow the known ones in alphabetical order
an entry without fields still produces a valid entry
an unbalanced value is quoted and reported
an empty entry list formats to an empty string
keys with spaces are normalised to underscores

dedupe_vectors.name: two entries with the same DOI collapse on the DOI rule
entries without title, author or year are never merged
an ISBN identifies a book entry
the deduplicated document is the canonical formatting of the surviving entries
dedupe_vectors.input:
@comment{nota, da ignorare}
@article{a, year = {2026}, title = {T}, author = {Ada Smith}}

properties: parsing then formatting an already canonical document is a fixed point
formatting never introduces an entry that parsing would not read back
